;Disasters and accidents
*Thirteen people are killed and 37 others injured after two buses collided between [[Caracas]] and [[Bolivar State]], [[Venezuela]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2017-05/03/c_136251819.htm (Xinhua)]
*Twelve people are killed and twelve injured after a gas explosion in a railway tunnel under construction in [[Guizhou Province]], [[China]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/world/blast-traps-kills-12-in-train-tunnel-being-built-in-china-4638293/?ref=archive_pg (The Indian Express)]
